reproduction.scope: standard library exact fractions; invented toy only

independent_conclusion: Gamma-Poisson integral, shared-kappa distinction, prior-only integration identity, active-observation counterexample and disclosed toy limits are correct.

parent_mass_coverage_gap.finding: Author toy's parent mass test has identical observation evidence for all parents; it cannot detect accidental reweighting by parent evidence. The README discloses this limitation.
parent_mass_coverage_gap.supplemental_result: Exact rational check keeps protected masses (1/8,7/8) after per-parent normalized nuisance integration despite parent evidence (1/4,3/4); ordinary Bayesian evidence reweight would yield (1/22,21/22). Passed.

continuous_shared_kappa_check.actual_prior_difference: The toy's finite kappa prior {1,2} differs from actual LogNormal(log(100),0.7).
continuous_shared_kappa_check.analytic_extension: For any nondegenerate positive kappa and lambda>0, q_lambda(kappa)=P(N=0|kappa,lambda)=(kappa/(kappa+lambda))^kappa has derivative d log q/dkappa=-log(1+lambda/kappa)+lambda/(kappa+lambda)<0. Two q functions are co-monotone, so shared-kappa joint zero probability E[q1 q2] is strictly greater than E[q1]E[q2], the independent-per-event-kappa probability.
continuous_shared_kappa_check.raw_count_covariance: Can remain zero because conditional means are kappa-independent; dependence is present in joint zero/tail events and higher-order moments.

active_observation: An observed Poisson count changes the kappa posterior; G may still be integrated conditional on kappa to a negative-binomial likelihood, but kappa is no longer prior-only and cannot simply be dropped.
fixed_parent_mass_semantics: Within each parent, normalized nuisance integration contributes factor one; preserve original outer masses. Do not multiply masses by parent evidence in a protected cut target.
